QA Tester (Athena Master)

 Summary

 We are seeking a highly skilled QA Tester to join our IT Services division, where you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the integrity and performance of our complex data ecosystems. This position is designed for a professional with 4 to 5 years of hands-on experience, offering a competitive annual compensation package of ₹10 LPA. The successful candidate will be responsible for validating robust data pipelines, managing integration workflows, and verifying the accuracy of streaming data processes. Your expertise will be crucial in maintaining high-quality standards across our Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions environments, ensuring seamless deployment and reliable software delivery.

 Responsibilities

• Execute comprehensive testing strategies using Selenium and Robot Framework to validate application functionality and user interfaces.

• Monitor and validate real-time data streams and streaming data integrity utilizing Kafka and related technologies.

• Perform deep-dive backend testing and SQL queries to verify data consistency across various system layers.

• Conduct rigorous ETL and data pipeline testing to ensure accurate transformation and movement of data between systems.

• Utilize OpenSearch and Elasticsearch for log analysis, performance monitoring, and data retrieval verification.

• Collaborate within CI/CD pipelines to automate testing processes and streamline deployment workflows.

• Validate Master Data Management (MDM) processes, with a focus on Reltio MDM where applicable, to ensure data governance and quality.

 Requirements

 Requirements: 

• Possess 4 to 5 years of professional experience in quality assurance within the IT Services sector.

• Demonstrate proficiency in Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions for continuous integration and deployment.

• Have strong practical experience with automation tools such as Selenium and the Robot Framework.

• Show capability in handling streaming data validation using Kafka.

• Be skilled in querying and analyzing data using SQL, with a solid understanding of backend testing methodologies.

• Experience with ETL processes and data pipeline validation is essential.

• Familiarity with OpenSearch or Elasticsearch is required for effective log and data analysis.

• Knowledge of Master Data Management (MDM) is highly desirable, specifically with Reltio MDM.
